I’ve attached a template SCIM mapping and the IP allowlist we typically use for sandbox vs. prod. Monica will follow with the MAP and an ask list.

Thanks,
Markus Klein

Subject: Mutual action plan & checklist: SSO/SCIM/IP/service-account ops (PrimeBank)

Hi Sara and Carlos —

Attaching a short MAP here and listing initial asks so we can lock dates. Proposed timeline (tweakable):
1) May 10 — share final SAML metadata + test IdP metadata (PrimeBank)
2) May 12 — Redwood provides SCIM mapping CSV filled with sample users (we’ll seed 10 test users)
3) May 15 — Staging IP allowlist applied; staging calls tested end-to-end
4) May 20 — Production cutover window (coordination with network/procurement)

Initial ask list (please reply inline):
- Confirm IdP SAML endpoint + cert rotation schedule
- Provide primary SCIM group attribute you use for role mapping (e.g., group.name or custom attr)
- Confirm CIDR(s) for staging vs prod firewall rules (we will send final snippet after you confirm)
- Confirm preferred service-account naming convention and maximum TTL (we suggest 48h for contractors; service-to-service can be 7d with rotation)

Attachments included with this email: MAP_PrimeBank_v1.docx (DOCX - 12KB), sample SAML metadata checklist (short) — I’ll upload both to the shared Drive folder and post links.

If procurement needs the SOW to be countersigned before we push any access requests, include the procurement email thread and we’ll expedite DocuSign.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: MAP_PrimeBank_v1.docx (DOCX - 12KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>
To: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@primebank.com>, Sara Liu <sara.liu@primebank.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodai.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodai.com>
Date: Mon, 07 May 2028 10:37:00 -0700
Subject: SCIM mapping template + IP allowlist details (technical)

Hi Carlos / Sara —

Uploading the SCIM group->role mapping template (attached). A few notes from the engineering side:
- SCIM: we support incremental group syncs and full re-provisioning. For initial onboarding, we recommend incremental membership syncs with filter=groups.name sw "prime-" to avoid pulling test groups.
- Attributes: map group.displayName -> redwood:role, userName -> externalId. If you have a custom attribute for environment, include it and we can map to tenancy.
- Service accounts: recommend names like rw-service-primebank-<purpose>-<env> and set TTLs to 48h for contractor SA, 168h for long-lived internal SAs with automated rotation.
- IP allowlist: attached json includes separate lists for staging and prod and notes for cloud egress ranges. Please ensure your egress NAT covers the staging block by May 15 for the test window.

Let me know if you want us to open a temporary SSH jumpbox to validate calls — we prefer testing over HTTPS from your existing CIDRs.

Ben Carter
Staff Engineer, Runtime Services
Redwood Inference

Attachments: PrimeBank_SCIM_group_mapping_v1.csv (CSV - updated), ip-allowlist.json (JSON - updated)
